question: Which of the following Indian Para Canoeists won the bronze medal in the 2022 International Canoe Federation's Paracanoe World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prachi Yadav.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prachi Yadav** won the **bronze medal** in the **2022 International Canoe Federation's** Paracanoe World Cup.
 
• Para Canoeing is a Paralympic sport that involves athletes with **physical disabilities **paddling kayaks or canoes in a race against each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ramya Smruti** is an **Indian Para Swimmer **who has won several medals at national and international events.
 
• **Sarita Rao** is a former Indian national champion in** canoeing and kayaking**.
 
• **Pranshi Rawal** is an **Indian Para Badminton player **who has won several medals at national and international events.
 
• All of the sports played during the Summer and Winter Paralympic Games are referred to as **Paralympic sports.**
 
• In 2020, there were** 22 sports and 539 medal events** in the Summer Paralympics, and roughly **80 events in 5 sports **and disciplines in the Winter Paralympics.
